item.title: Apple Unveils Mac Studio M5 Max & Ultra: Pure Power
item.description: Apple's new Mac Studio models, powered by M5 Max and the record‑breaking M5 Ultra, bring PCIe Gen 6 SSDs, Thunderbolt 5, Wi‑Fi 7, and AI‑centric performance.

item.title: Apple Launches New Mac mini & Mac Studio – Pre‑Orders
item.description: Apple opens pre‑orders for refreshed Mac mini (M6, M5 Pro) and Mac Studio (M5 Max, M5 Ultra) with new pricing, AI‑driven chip cost pressures, and September 22 shipping.

item.title: Apple Unveils New Mac Studio with M5 Max & Ultra
item.description: Apple unveils a new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra silicon, delivering a fresh performance tier for creators and professional workflows.

item.title: Apple Updates Mac mini & Mac Studio with M6, M5 Max, M5 Ultra
item.description: Apple's refreshed Mac mini and Mac Studio debut M6, M5 Max, and M5 Ultra silicon, boosting AI and graphics performance while raising entry prices.

item.title: Apple M5 Ultra vs M3 Ultra: Architecture & Performance
item.description: A deep dive into Apple’s new M5 Ultra chip for Mac Studio, comparing its quad‑die design, CPU/GPU gains, memory bandwidth, and AI capabilities against the M3 Ultra.

item.title: Apple M6 Mac Mini & M5 Ultra Mac Studio: Specs & Pricing
item.description: Apple introduces the 2nm M6 Mac Mini and quad‑die M5 Ultra Mac Studio, boosting CPU, GPU, and AI performance while raising prices and shipping Sep 22.

item.title: Apple Unveils New Mac Studio with M5 Max & Ultra
item.description: Apple refreshes Mac Studio with M5 Max and new M5 Ultra chips, unifying the line and delivering unprecedented performance in the same compact chassis.

item.title: Apple Unveils M6 Mac Mini & M5 Ultra Mac Studio
item.description: Apple refreshes Mac Mini and Mac Studio with M6 and M5 Ultra chips, delivering AI gains, Wi‑Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and shipping from Sep 22, 2026.
